description: yaml.Unmarshal without KnownFields silently ignores unknown/typo'd keys, so a mistyped knob (always_prox) no-ops with no warning
onnxruntime-purego pinned to a commit pseudo-version (v0.0.0-20260315...), so go get -u cannot track a release line for the -tags ner path

streaming NIM responses are buffered whole: the body is ReadAll'd (up to 128MB) and only then copied to the client, so a stream's first byte waits for the whole generation. pipe lastResp.Body for isStream and tee the usage tail only
upstreamBodyLimit 128MB x up to 16 in-flight slots = ~2GB peak, and debug mode keeps a second copy (respBodyBuf); the comment calls it a bound against memory exhaustion
lastKey/ModelLock stop inserting at 4096 distinct model ids and never evict, so stickiness and per-key model lockouts silently stop applying to new ids
uint16be panics on an oversized length instead of returning an error; fine while every call site is ours, but a peer-driven path would take the whole proxy down

--dbg-file writes one JSON per failed request (bodies included, 256KB/hop) into nimroute-debug/ with no count cap, size cap, rotation or pruning; docs/troubleshooting.md recommends it for 429 storms, i.e. the case that writes a file per failure
freepiClientStatus keys off a substring of the error message rather than the parsed code field; it works only because freepiFetch appends (code X) to the text

globMatch locates pattern parts anywhere in order, unanchored: claude-* matches my-claude-x and a wildcard-free pattern matches any id containing it; backs route.exclude_models, claude_map and nudge overrides, which all over-match silently

buildRouteTable re-unions every backend catalog per route request, per /v1/models hit and per 1Hz /status poll, and falls back to an uncached 10s-timeout GET /models on the request path when ocInfo is empty
anthropic race path records every losing candidate's latency (openai-compat path at :323 records under `if won` and documents why), feeding the EWMA behind the latency strategy with losers

outcomesByModel grows one 20-entry ring per client-chosen model id with no cap, while totals is capped at 4096 for exactly this reason; the health map is also serialized into /status, which clients poll continuously

verifyProxy treats every non-200 as a dead proxy, including 429/403 from the shared public key: a chat-capable exit that is busy on GET /models is written off for the whole sweep. an independent curl probe matched the same ~1-in-10 dial rate, so today's losses are real, but log the status mix to catch false negatives

init panics on a malformed embedded ballast json; fail-fast on a build-time constant is defensible, noted because it is a hard crash in the serving binary and the ballast is load-bearing for the free-tier gate

t.Skip("no verified pool available to escalate onto") (and :2857, :639, todo_small_test.go:113) make a missing fixture read as a pass; the pool one guards the pin/rotation invariant the project rests on
